customManagers.description: Track the Simple English plugin pinned in claude-review.yml, which supplies the `@claude review` output style. github-actions pins a `uses:` SHA but never reads a `ref:` under `with:`, so this checkout is invisible to Renovate without this manager. Captures digest + tag to match the `<sha> # <tag>` convention the SHA-pinned actions already use.

Track the tools that lint.yml installs by version. Each pin carries a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above its `<NAME>_VERSION:` env value, so one pattern covers any annotated pin. github-actions never reads these env values. Today the pin is jactionlint: the release archive (`datasource=github-releases depName=jdx/jactionlint`) with an adjacent JACTIONLINT_SHA256, which the jdx/jactionlint packageRule below refreshes in-branch.

packageRules.description: ⚠️ Hold every Simple English plugin bump for review. Its hooks run inside the review step, next to the review credentials: the Anthropic identity token on the default api path, and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN on the oauth path. Read the hook sources at the new SHA before the bump merges. The workflow also verifies the style id still resolves against the new checkout, so a bump that moves the plugin layout fails loudly instead of degrading to the default style.

Hold every claude-code-action bump for review. Every caller's `@claude review` runs this action on the oauth path, and the hardening (exact allow rules, guard hook, Read denies) depends on its tag-mode tool list and on the CLI version it pins. Before merging, read src/modes/tag/index.ts at the new version and re-run the headless guard and symlink tests.

Hold every Claude Code bump of the `auth: api` path (.github/claude-review/package.json and its lockfile) for review, for the same reason as claude-code-action: the guard hook, the allow rules and the setting-sources isolation must still hold on the new CLI.

Wait 3 days after a jactionlint release before proposing it, so a bad release has time to be yanked. `jdx/jactionlint` (github-releases) is the release-archive pin in lint.yml. `jactionlint` (pypi) is the earlier `uv tool install` pin, kept so the wait also covers it until shared-workflows PR 40 lands. After the wait, the base auto-merge policy applies.

Refresh the sha256 of a jactionlint bump. Renovate updates JACTIONLINT_VERSION in lint.yml but cannot recompute the adjacent JACTIONLINT_SHA256 (the linux amd64 release archive digest). Self-hosted Renovate CE refreshes it in-branch via the postUpgradeTask (scripts/check_binary_dep_pins.py --fix rewrites JACTIONLINT_SHA256 from GitHub's published asset digest), so version and hash land in one commit. The lint job then checks the archive with `sha256sum -c` and `gh attestation verify`, so a stale hash or a tampered archive fails CI and blocks the merge. With the refresh, the bump follows the base auto-merge policy. The command must be on RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS.
